item.title: Top Gear for Women from SHOT Show 2026: Gear Up!
item.description: SHOT Show 2026 lost a fragment of its thunder with the anticipated arrival of “Winter Storm Fern.” Predictions of this “once-in-a-decade” event had attendees and manufacturers scrambling to get out and get home before it hit. Aside from the worry and commotion, it was still a great SHOT Show, especially when it came to guns and gear for women. item.title: Barrett REC10 – Returns to the Lineup
item.description: Several years ago, I had the opportunity to test-drive a new Barrett rifle. It was the first release of the REC 10, and it was a sexy, accurate, easy shooting beast. I fell in love with it and considered it to be one of the best professional-level rifles I have run. It had great potential, but sometimes success gets in the way. item.title: Rugged Suppressors Sub9: A Compact, Hard-Use Can Built for Subguns and PCCs
item.description: The new Rugged Suppressors Sub9 is a purpose-built 9mm suppressor designed specifically for subguns and pistol caliber carbines (PCCs). The Sub9 will keep your setup compact, while making it impressively quiet. Sub9: Compact But Serious At just 6.8 inches long with the included mount (6.6 inches without) and 1.73 inches in diameter, the Sub9 maintains a compact profile ideal for keeping subguns short and maneuverable. item.title: Shooting 101: Do Pistol Grip Safeties Make It Safer or a Liability?
item.description: Grip safeties on a pistol have been around since at least the introduction of the 1911 pistol, with at least one revolver using them in the late 1800’s. They still exist on most 1911 pistols today, as well as a few others. But do they make your pistol safer? Or are they a liability? item.title: SHOT 2026: ARs & AR Pistols
item.description: There were a variety of new ARs and AR pistols this year at SHOT Show. Many were chambered in 5.56 or 300 BLK, but a few new rifles were released in 6.5 Creedmoor, 300 Win Mag, .338 ARC, and a new caliber, .30 EPIC. item.title: Shooting 101: Getting Started Shooting Skeet
item.description: Skeet is an exciting, fast-paced shotgun game that anyone—from experts who seldom miss to brand-new shooters— can enjoy. item.title: SHOT Show 2026: The Latest in Less Lethal
item.description: SHOT Show is the largest trade show in the firearms industry, but lethal gear like guns and ammo are but a sizeable subsect of the show. You will find the latest in cutlery, vehicle modifications, accessories, safe storage options. Also included are less-lethal options that are used to disarm threats to prevent lethal force in the first place. item.title: The Taurus Judge – Celebrating 20 Years
item.description: In the firearms world, there are occasionally pivotal moments. Twenty years ago, a simple video changed the firearms industry forever. A revolutionary handgun obliterating watermelons became the first gun video to go viral—and introduced the world to a new category of handgun. That firearm was the Taurus Judge.
